title: Arm B — Authored Scene Manifest
description: Emitted by whatsapp_mvp/authored/scene_author.py alongside its generated AuthoredScene.tsx (Phase 8) — NOT a render props file like render_props.schema.json. render_props.schema.json describes a FIXED vocabulary of card sections that XiaojinEditorial always renders; this describes a PER-JOB, model-chosen list of the specific elements in THIS generated scene that a human is allowed to tweak afterward. Everything not listed here stays entirely under the model's control (layout, animation, b-roll timing choices not exposed as a window, etc). Every field listed against an element MUST be read in the generated TSX as `props.overrides?.[id]?.<field> ?? <authored default>` — tsx_validator.py's contract_overrides_used/manifest-id-wired checks enforce that this isn't decorative.

id.description: Stable within this scene — must appear verbatim in the TSX as an overrides lookup key (e.g. props.overrides?.['stat-1']).

layer.description: Paint/z-order — same role as remotion-composer/editor/state/layers.ts's DEFAULT_CONTENT_LAYER for Arm A. Higher paints on top; used for topmost-first click-to-select.

x.description: Composition px, 1080x1920 space (same convention as render_props.schema.json's card x/y).

textBlockFields.description: An on-screen text/caption-style graphic beat (NOT the burned-in word-level captions themselves, which stay model-only — only discrete graphic text the model chose to add).

statCardFields.description: A discrete data/number graphic beat (countdown, gauge, data-card equivalent, model's own design — not one of Arm A's fixed card types, just editable the same way).

imageSwapFields.description: A still image the model placed (not a b-roll video window — see broll_window for that).

src.description: Path relative to remotion-composer/public/, same convention as render_props.schema.json's videoSrc.

brollWindowFields.description: One of the b-roll insert windows scene_author.py's prompt already asks the model to place — made editable so a human can nudge its timing or swap the clip without a full re-author.
